description: Every Apple Ads keyword bought for one app across its campaigns (last 28 days), by spend: bid, match type, ad group, spend, impressions, taps, installs, tap-through rate, conversion rate, cost per tap and cost per install, with the app's organic rank for the same word in the country next to it (tracked:false when the word is not tracked). Pass campaign to narrow to one campaign. connected=false means Apple Ads is not connected.

campaign.description: campaign id to narrow to one campaign

country.description: country code for the organic rank column (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_ads_keywords
